function.name: import_wearable_data
function.description: Import wearable data from a local export directory or GPX file, normalize it through adapters, and write it into the local wearable store. Phase 1 supports Xiaomi export directories, Huawei Health export directories, and GPX files.

source_type.description: Upstream wearable source. Local export adapters support Xiaomi and Huawei export directories; API adapters are placeholders in Phase 1.

path.description: Absolute local directory path or file path

function.name: query_wearable_trend
function.description: Query wearable trends from the unified local store for 7d/30d/90d windows. Returns structured aggregates, baselines, quality, and exercise summaries.

eid.description: Patient identifier. Optional if load_patient already set the current patient.

function.name: summarize_wearable_status
function.description: Generate a high-level summary of cardiovascular, metabolic, sleep, or general wearable status from trend features.

function.name: detect_wearable_anomalies
function.description: Detect wearable anomalies from recent daily summaries using persistent baseline deviation and absolute thresholds.

function.name: integrate_clinical_wearable
function.description: Integrate clinical evidence and wearable trends to produce rule-based risk signals and lifestyle recommendations. Use after load_patient and query_wearable_trend or summarize_wearable_status.
